messages:
erin: Heads-up: starting a scoped dry-run for the shim+header swap at 03:00 UTC. Targets: api, runtime, console, router. Goal: validate quarantine routing, header compatibility, and rollback commands. @lucas @anya please confirm any staging pins.
lucas: Ack. Runtime has a perf pin on pool-a (v5-canary). I'll unpin at T-20 if canaries look good.
anya: Console flag console.header_v3 staged in feature-flags. I'll toggle for the dry-run subset and revert afterwards. Release notes draft: https://go/release/1999999.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary start: id=srm-1999999-1 services=[api,version-bridge,runtime] footprint=staging ttl=7m monitors=[latency,5xx,auth_errors]
ops-bot: [ops-bot] Alert policy loaded: abort if 5xx > 0.6% sustained 2m OR auth_errors > 0.4% 1m.
erin: Rollback policy: prefer single-service rollback (runtime) for perf regressions; pair rollback (router+console) for header/schema contract failures. I'll make the criteria explicit in the change window note.
lucas: Noted. If we see kv eviction thrash, prefer transient config (reduce batch size) before rollback. I can push config to canary.
anya: Flipped console.header_v3=true on 10% subset in staging. Confirm route mapping with version-bridge works.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary metrics update: latency +1.8%, errors 0.07%, auth_errors 0.01%. No automated abort.
erin: Observing a small auth reject increase on api-shard-7 (0 -> 0.25%). Could be parsing edge-case. Version-bridge should accept both shapes; lucas, can runtime tolerate both header variants?
lucas: Runtime accepts both. The parsing shim is in compatibility mode for 30m. I'll watch.
anya: Reverted console subset for that shard to old header shape to verify. Revert successful, rejects dropped.
lucas: Applied transient config to canary: max_batch_tokens 4096 -> 2048. KV churn dropped.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary wave complete: id=srm-1999999-1 status=ok. No abort.
erin: Next step: router header-swap smoke at 15% traffic for 5m. Abort if errors > 0.4% in 1m.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] Dashboard links: telemetry https://go/dash/1999999 logs https://go/logs/srm/1999999.
anya: Router smoke started for 15% slice.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Router smoke update: errors 0.02%, latency stable.
erin: Looks good. We'll prepare final change window notice with rollback snippets and runbook pointers. I'll post T-30 signoff. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
